about.text: A semi-hard cow's milk cheese made in the region of Mols. It is very similar to Edam, with a delicate, light flavour that is slightly tangy and salty. It has small, regular holes and is covered in a red wax coating.

sources.text: Edam-like, red wax; Wikipedia gives no ripening time
